items.title: Google brings the Gemini app to Apple CarPlay
items.excerpt: The chatbot was already available through the Google Maps app.
items.rationale: Gemini lands as a standalone app on CarPlay, so iPhone drivers get Google's assistant in the dash; this is a new platform launch.

items.title: Blue Phone gives Google's Pixel 10 Pro an AI assistant that goes beyond Gemini
items.excerpt: Blue phone brings an AI-powered operating system to Pixel 10 Pro, letting an assistant handle tasks across apps.
items.rationale: A third-party agentic OS on a Pixel that acts across apps. It is a concrete new product in the AI-phone race.

items.title: Bizarre AI chip demo uses butter to highlight how new chip runs 40 degrees cooler than the competition
items.excerpt: South Korean chip startup DEEPX says its new AI chip will be at the heart of upcoming Hyundai robots.
items.rationale: A memorable demo of a low-heat edge AI chip from a Korean company, with a Hyundai robot tie-in. It covers on-device AI hardware.

items.title: Gigabyte takes on Mac Studio with a tiny AI PC powered by Nvidia RTX Spark
items.excerpt: Gigabyte has launched the AI Top Aero, a compact desktop powered by Nvidia's RTX Spark platform and designed for local AI development, content creation and gaming. Its one-liter chassis packs a 20-core Grace CPU, a Blackwell GPU and up to 128 GB of memory, making it a Windows-bas
items.rationale: A newly launched one-litre RTX Spark desktop with 128GB for local AI and creative work. It is a buyable Windows alternative to the Mac Studio.

items.title: Google Home update fixes Nest 'Live View' issues, improves Nest Hub and Gemini for speakers
items.excerpt: A new Google Home update is rolling out with a fix for “Live View” issues affecting Nest Cam devices, improvements...
items.rationale: The November Google Home release improves Gemini on speakers and the Nest Hub. It is a new rollout that differs from the 10-30 phrase-bug fix.
